stories.title: Fix QMD (obsidian-qmd) bot review issues

UI text uses sentence case in settings-tab.ts, related-view.ts, search-modal.ts
onClose in related-view.ts is not async (no await inside)
submitCurrentQuery in search-modal.ts is not async (no await inside)
settings-tab.ts uses new Setting().setHeading() instead of direct HTML heading elements
Unnecessary type assertion removed from query-builder.ts
Object stringification fixed in parser.ts (String() cast for unknown fields)
pnpm ci passes in obsidian-qmd directory
Changes committed and pushed to main branch of obsidian-qmd
